claims.rationale: MIT Lincoln original developer account, Inaugural scan and Farewell, dates launch, first scan and 2017 retirement; USGS EO-1 overview and January notices distinguish imagery wind-down from archive availability. NASA first images corroborates successful Alaska observations. Archived scene dates are not invention dates.

NASA Landsat 8 mission, First Light, dates the Colorado image 18 March 2013. Knight and Kvaran 2014 sections 1.2 and 2.1 describe Ball OLI development and focal-plane modules. MIT Lincoln Instrument impact independently confirms ALI design transfer to OLI. builds_on points from later OLI to ALI and identifies the specific design contribution.

USGS EROS December 2020 release and USGS Landsat 8 C2 Level 2 Science Product Guide executive summary support archive release and the distinct OLI reflectance/TIRS temperature. The guide and Google Earth Engine LC08 C2 L2 bands support uses_instrument on the later collection specifically for Landsat 8 reflectance; other missions are not attributed to OLI.

Developer Mueller, GA release history opening and Historical challenge, dates 2014 product and describes NFRIP impetus, and Mueller et al. 2016 introduction and methods describe Landsat 5/7 decision-tree analysis. Product publication is distinguished from archive observation years.

DE Africa July–September 2021 quarterly report p.12 dates September operational release; Halabisky et al. 2024 abstract, sections 1, 2.1, 2.3 document Africa-wide service, collaborative validation and Australian method transfer. GA DEA Water Observations independently confirms method use in Africa. DE Africa WOfS specs Table 1 and processing, and Halabisky section 2.3 establish the separate Collection 2 reflectance input. adapts and builds_on point toward the Australian service and the later Collection 2 data respectively; neither means OpenET borrowed the WOfS classifier.

USGS OpenET launch 21 October 2021 and NASA 16 December 2025 coverage history support the two distinct public availability events and 17 to 48 state scope. OpenET Methods SSEBop v0.2.6 states Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 temperature; OpenET code input collections and Kandhway et al. 2026 section 2.3 corroborate the specific deployed model and Landsat scenes. builds_on points to the collection and is limited to later SSEBop implementation; no claim of this input at original launch.

Inventory: USGS September 2026 and NASA 2025 establish OpenET scope; DE Africa STAC fa9b7581-8e3c-5c7b-af64-5f4920036c5b independently read on 17 November records 15 November Landsat 9 scene and 16 November 2026 creation (one scene, not complete platform uptime); MIT and USGS support EO-1 retired with imagery archive. Trace preserves distinct surface water and agricultural ET products. Kandhway et al. 2026 section 2.3 supports VIIRS alternate in one region; USGS 2026 update describes separate global product. Original 2021 OpenET manifest and broader WOfS update reliability remain frontier questions.

Source entries and notes cover the original operator, developer and cited manuscript passages for above bounded claims. Knight and Kvaran author and section correction verified at DOI 10.3390/rs61110286. Source notes are paraphrases, not original source copies; access and item limitations remain visible. Repository snapshot text search found no matching named canonical nodes; absence of a match is not proof of historical novelty.

Month precision retained for Collection 2 release because USGS reports differ on precise day.
